declared_before: Any provider record acquisition or signal output inspection in this sprint
construct: Observed lexical prevalence in titles within a bounded scholarly corpus; not emergence, impact, adoption or causal change

domain_shortlist.reason: Pre-2019 fuzzing survey supplies independent concept context; arXiv cs.SE is a bounded category, though not representative of all testing research
No comparably inspected pre-cutoff concept context in this sprint; no claim of inferior provider coverage
No comparably inspected pre-cutoff concept context in this sprint; avoids expanding literature workload

overflow: Stop, report bound exceeded; no first-N representative sample
sampling: Attempt exhaustive retrieval of the declared six-month current query, not a population-representative sample
version_probe: Request explicit v1 for all retrieved work IDs in batches of at most 100; compare title/category with current metadata
candidate_holdout: 2019-07-01 through 2019-12-31; not acquired or evaluated in this sprint
case_selection: Fuzzing chosen from independent 2018 survey before signal inspection; not assumed to increase
control: Synthetic constant-share corpus-growth null; checks confounding only, not external detection validity
numerator: distinct works with candidate pattern in v1 title
denominator: all distinct works returned by declared current-category query in bin, including nonmatches
temporal_rule: v1 retrieval and old published dates alone do not establish historical category membership, public availability time or vocabulary availability
min_support: UNRESOLVED; do not issue trend labels
quality_threshold: UNRESOLVED; no independent reference annotations yet
holdout_rule: No holdout execution until owner accepts D07/D08 and versioned experiment contract
access: Public anonymous metadata, one connection, minimum 3 seconds between requests; no secrets or paid service
retention: CC0 descriptive metadata and response provenance; no paper PDFs redistributed
stop_rule: Stop on access/rate-limit failure; report observed failure without treating it as provider-wide incapability
